verdict.rationale: An AI gateway or LLMOps platform could plausibly offer user-defined background automations such as scheduled jobs or workflows, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows per-request gateway behaviors (automatic fallbacks, retries, load balancing, caching) and budget-limit resets. These are adjacent reliability and governance features, not automations a user sets up to run autonomously in the background, so no credit is earned.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
